section.label: Exhibit 03
section.title: The Memory Hall
section.lede: A long corridor of moments I kept. Some are big. Most are small. All of them are yours.
section.hint: Walk slowly. Click a frame to stay in the moment a little longer.

memories.title: The Little You
memories.caption: You might not love this photo, but I really do. It's you, before the world got to you.
memories.message: I know you might not be your biggest fan in this picture, but I am. This little version of you is where everything started, and I love her for becoming the woman I adore. You were already you, even then.

memories.title: Growing Into You
memories.caption: Every year added something beautiful.
memories.message: This is you becoming yourself. Not perfect, not trying to be — just growing, learning, and becoming the person I fell for. I wouldn't change a single chapter.

memories.title: Us
memories.caption: The two of us, in one frame.
memories.message: This is one of my favorite moments of us. Not because it was a big occasion, but because it was just you and me, being together. I hope there are a hundred more like this.

memories.title: The Family That Loves You
memories.caption: Insert your whole family that loves you.
memories.message: This is the family that loves you. Not every member could fit in this single photo, so think of this frame as a doorway to all of them. They're part of the reason you are who you are, and I'm grateful for every one of them. You were loved long before I met you, and you'll be loved long after — but I'm glad I get to be part of that story now.
